subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about reactivating dormant payers for {Brand} between the paywall view and the first paid subscription. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the reactivated paid subscription confirmed server-side through App Store Server Notifications v2 and Google Play RTDN, so you pay only for clean, validated resubscribes and never for an organic renewal. On the recovered cohort we hold a D30 retention of 62%, the active-member quality bar your tier looks for. Worth a quick look at the recovery view?
angle: warm bump, restate validated-resubscribe + recovered-cohort retention proof
illustrative_flags: D30 retention 62% on the recovered cohort (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN social_and_dating: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (server-side validated resubscribe via ASSN v2 + Google Play RTDN, pay only for validated subscriptions); one illustrative MobUpps figure (D30 62% recovered cohort, framed as quality bar); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native US register; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em-dash.
